<script>
// Capture every wrapper event for the Playwright specs.
document.addEventListener('gsm-viz-select', function (e) {
  (window.__gsmEvents = window.__gsmEvents || []).push(e.detail);
});
</script>

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(gsm.vizr)
```

## Basic vertical stack (count)

<div id="page-basic">
```{r basic}
dfSites <- data.frame(
  site = rep(c("S-001", "S-002", "S-003"), times = c(5, 3, 2)),
  flag = rep(c("2", "1", "2", "1", "0"), times = 2)
)
bars(dfSites, list(mapping = list(x = "site", fill = "flag")),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-basic")
)
```
</div>

## Single-level factors (order arrays of length one)

<div id="page-singleton">
```{r singleton}
# One level on both aesthetics is the case auto_unbox would collapse to
# "order":"S1". Upstream then calls explicitOrder.filter() on a string and dies
# with an uncaught TypeError, so the chart is blank and R reports nothing. This
# page is the browser-side proof that .normalize_spec_arrays() prevents it.
dfSingle <- data.frame(
  site = factor("S-001", levels = "S-001"),
  flag = factor("2", levels = "2")
)
bars(dfSingle, bars_spec(x = "site", fill = "flag"),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-singleton")
)
```
</div>

## Facet dispatch

<div id="page-facet">
```{r facet}
# Guards the facet branch of the binding: bars() and facet_bars() share one
# htmlwidget, so the only thing routing to facetBars is the presence of the
# facet payload slot. Later tasks edit this binding repeatedly.
dfFacet <- data.frame(
  site = rep(c("S-001", "S-002"), 4),
  flag = rep(c("2", "1"), each = 4),
  country = rep(c("USA", "CAN"), each = 4)
)
facet_bars(dfFacet, bars_spec(x = "site", fill = "flag"),
  # An explicit facet order also covers the small-multiples case: facet$order
  # never passes through .derive_orders(), so this is the array slot that only
  # .normalize_spec_arrays() protects.
  facet_spec("country", order = c("USA", "CAN"), nCol = 2),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-facet")
)
```
</div>

<div id="page-hooks">

## Selection enabled (click-to-select)

<div id="page-select">

## Selection on a pre-aggregated (identity) chart

<div id="page-select-identity">
```{r select-identity}
# Same event contract, different `datum` shape. Upstream sets point._datum to
# the single contributing row under stat "identity" (structureData.js) but to
# the array of aggregated rows under stat "count" (aggregateCounts.js). The
# wrapper forwards it unchanged, so both shapes reach consumers and both are
# asserted in events.spec.js.
dfIdentity <- data.frame(
  site = c("S-001", "S-002"),
  n = c(5, 3),
  flag = c("2", "1")
)
bars(
  dfIdentity,
  bars_spec(
    x = "site", y = "n", fill = "flag", stat = "identity",
    selection = list(enabled = TRUE)
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-select-identity", level = "site")
)
```
</div>

## Dynamic sizing with the minHeight floor (2 categories)

<div id="page-dynamic">
```{r dynamic}
bars(
  data.frame(site = c("S1", "S2"), n = c(4, 2)),
  bars_spec(
    x = "site", y = "n", stat = "identity", orientation = "horizontal",
    theme = list(dynamicSizing = TRUE)
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-dynamic")
)
```
</div>

## Horizontal stack, identity, named colors, captions

<div id="page-hbar">
```{r hbar}
dfFlags <- data.frame(
  invid = factor(rep(c("INV-3", "INV-1", "INV-2"), each = 2),
    levels = c("INV-3", "INV-1", "INV-2")
  ),
  flag = factor(rep(c("2", "1"), times = 3), levels = c("2", "1")),
  n = c(5, 2, 4, 1, 2, 2)
)
bars(dfFlags,
  bars_spec(
    x = "invid", y = "n", fill = "flag",
    orientation = "horizontal", stat = "identity",
    scales = list(fill = list(colors = c(`2` = "#c91b1d", `1` = "#fdb84c"))),
    labels = list(captions = c("Footnote line 1.", "Footnote line 2."))
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-hbar-stack")
)
```
</div>

## Identity single series + frequency sort + Top-N

<div id="page-ordering">
```{r ordering}
dfCounts <- data.frame(site = sprintf("S-%02d", 1:8), n = c(9, 3, 7, 1, 5, 2, 8, 4))
bars(dfCounts, bars_spec(x = "site", y = "n", stat = "identity"),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-identity")
)
bars(dfCounts, bars_spec(
  x = "site", y = "n", stat = "identity",
  scales = list(x = list(sort = "total", sortDir = "desc"))
),
metadata = list(chartId = "chart-sort-total")
)
bars(dfCounts, bars_spec(x = "site", y = "n", stat = "identity", nCategories = 3),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-topn")
)
```

## gsm.qtl replica — participant-level counts, horizontal, footnotes

<div id="page-qtl">
```{r qtl-replica}
# Participant-level rows (stat count), horizontal, position fill, captions,
# minHeight floor: the exact shape of the gsm.qtl eligibility functions.
# position = "fill" is load-bearing - it is what makes this a 100%-normalized
# chart rather than a raw stack. Rows stay participant-level so gsm.viz does
# the counting before it normalizes.
set.seed(158)
dfSubj <- data.frame(
  invid = factor(sample(sprintf("INV-%d", 1:6), 60, replace = TRUE)),
  category = factor(sample(c("Eligible", "Excluded", "Pending"), 60, replace = TRUE),
    levels = c("Eligible", "Excluded", "Pending")
  )
)
bars(dfSubj,
  bars_spec(
    x = "invid", fill = "category", orientation = "horizontal",
    position = "fill",
    theme = list(dynamicSizing = TRUE),
    labels = list(captions = c(
      "Counts of participants by investigator.",
      "Source: synthetic gallery data."
    ))
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-qtl-replica")
)
```
</div>

## gsm.endpoints replica — pre-aggregated stack, in-bar labels, 2-line tooltip

<div id="page-endpoints">
```{r endpoints-replica}
dfPfs <- data.frame(
  site = rep(c("S-001", "S-002", "S-003"), each = 2),
  status = factor(rep(c("Event", "Censored"), times = 3),
    levels = c("Event", "Censored")
  ),
  n = c(12, 30, 7, 25, 15, 18),
  pct = c(28.6, 71.4, 21.9, 78.1, 45.5, 54.5)
)
bars(dfPfs,
  bars_spec(
    x = "site", y = "n", fill = "status", stat = "identity",
    scales = list(fill = list(colors = c(Event = "#c91b1d", Censored = "#4e79a7"))),
    annotations = list(labels = list(segment = list(display = TRUE))),
    tooltip = list(formatter = js_hook(
      "function (value, context, details) {
         var d = (details && details.datum) || {};
         return [d.status + ': ' + d.n, 'Rate: ' + d.pct + '%'];
       }"
    ))
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-endpoints-replica")
)
```
</div>

## PD-pattern widget on the shared dependency (no bars())

<div id="page-pd">
```{r pd-dependency}
# A downstream package's custom widget: raw htmltools + the shared bundle
# dependency, calling gsmViz.default.bars directly (the gsm.kri PD pattern).
htmltools::attachDependencies(
  htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::div(id = "chart-pd-dependency", class = "gsm-vizr"),
    htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML(sprintf(
      "document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
         var el = document.getElementById('chart-pd-dependency');
         el.gsmChart = gsmViz.default.bars(el, %s, %s);
       });",
      jsonlite::toJSON(data.frame(bucket = c("AE", "PD", "Other"), n = c(4, 2, 1)),
        dataframe = "rows", na = "null", auto_unbox = TRUE
      ),
      jsonlite::toJSON(list(mapping = list(x = "bucket", y = "n"), stat = "identity"),
        auto_unbox = TRUE
      )
    )))
  ),
  html_dependency_gsm_viz()
)
```
</div>

## Driving a chart from a static report — `chart.helpers`, no Shiny

<div id="page-static-helpers">
```{r static-helpers}
# THE access path for static rmarkdown consumers. bars_proxy() requires a Shiny
# session; gsm.endpoints' reports and gsm.kri's Report_PrematureDeaths.Rmd are
# plain `output: html_document`, so their drilldowns must call chart.helpers
# from report JS instead. Everything the proxy verbs wrap is reachable here.
dfStatic <- data.frame(
  site = rep(c("S-001", "S-002", "S-003"), times = c(4, 3, 2)),
  flag = rep(c("2", "1", "0"), times = 3)
)
htmltools::tagList(
  bars(dfStatic,
    bars_spec(x = "site", fill = "flag", selection = list(enabled = TRUE)),
    metadata = list(chartId = "chart-static-helpers")
  ),
  htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML(sprintf(
    "window.__staticRows = %s;",
    jsonlite::toJSON(dfStatic, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE)
  ))),
  htmltools::tags$button(
    id = "btn-static-update", "drop S-003",
    onclick = "var ch = document.getElementById('chart-static-helpers').gsmChart;
               ch.helpers.updateData(ch, window.__staticRows.filter(
                 function (r) { return r.site !== 'S-003'; }), ch.data._spec_);"
  ),
  htmltools::tags$button(
    id = "btn-static-select", "select S-001",
    onclick = "var ch = document.getElementById('chart-static-helpers').gsmChart;
               ch.helpers.selectCategory(ch, ['S-001'], undefined, {_silent: true});"
  )
)
```
</div>

## gsm.qtl replica 2 — pre-aggregated identity stack (the dominant real shape)

<div id="page-qtl-identity">
```{r qtl-identity}
# The count + position="fill" replica above covers bPercentage. But 7 of the 8
# charts on gsm.kri's Report_Eligibility.Rmd are PRE-AGGREGATED (summarize/count)
# horizontal plain stacks - stat = "identity". The mode matters beyond shape:
# it decides whether event `datum` is one row or an array of rows.
#
# Also the title carrier: gsm.viz supports a chart title (labels$title) and
# axis titles (scales$x$label / scales$y$label), which every gsm.endpoints
# chart and all 8 eligibility charts set.
dfElig <- data.frame(
  invid = factor(rep(sprintf("INV-%d", 1:4), each = 3),
    levels = sprintf("INV-%d", 4:1)
  ),
  criteria = factor(rep(c("Ineligible", "No Eligibility Risk", "Neither"), 4),
    levels = c("Ineligible", "No Eligibility Risk", "Neither")
  ),
  n = c(3, 8, 1, 5, 6, 2, 1, 9, 3, 4, 4, 4)
)
bars(dfElig,
  bars_spec(
    x = "invid", y = "n", fill = "criteria", stat = "identity",
    orientation = "horizontal",
    scales = list(
      x = list(label = "Investigator"),
      y = list(label = "Participants"),
      fill = list(colors = c(
        Ineligible = "#FF5859", `No Eligibility Risk` = "#00BFC4",
        Neither = "#7CAE00"
      ))
    ),
    labels = list(
      title = "Eligibility criteria by investigator",
      captions = paste(
        "Participants screened between 2026-01-01 and 2026-06-30;",
        "sites with fewer than 5 screened are pooled into INV-4."
      )
    )
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-qtl-identity")
)
```
</div>

## Outside total labels — known-limitation reproduction case

<div id="page-outside-labels">
```{r outside-labels}
# 5 of the 8 eligibility charts render outside total labels (geom_text with
# nudge + a scale expansion reserving room). Upstream clips them near the axis
# maximum; this page is the reproduction case for that ask, NOT a passing
# fidelity demo. The assertions only check the labels are configured and the
# chart renders - the clipping itself stays visible and documented.
bars(data.frame(site = sprintf("S-%02d", 1:5), n = c(9, 22, 14, 3, 25)),
  bars_spec(
    x = "site", y = "n", stat = "identity", orientation = "horizontal",
    annotations = list(labels = list(
      total = list(display = TRUE, placement = "outside")
    ))
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-outside-labels")
)
```
</div>

## dynamicSizing above the floor (24 categories at the gsm.qtl growth rate)

<div id="page-dynamic-many">
```{r dynamic-many}
# chart-dynamic has 2 categories, so the 500px floor always wins and the
# per-category growth rate is never observed. Real eligibility and KRI reports
# run 20+ sites, where dynamicSizing governs and minHeight is irrelevant.
# gsm.qtl's calc_fig_size() grows at 25px/site: max(500, 25 * n). gsm.viz
# exposes that rate as theme$pxPerCategory (default 30), so the growth rate is
# reproducible rather than a known divergence - this page pins it at 25.
set.seed(24)
dfMany <- data.frame(
  invid = factor(rep(sprintf("INV-%02d", 1:24), each = 2)),
  flag = factor(rep(c("2", "1"), 24), levels = c("2", "1")),
  n = sample(1:9, 48, replace = TRUE)
)
bars(dfMany,
  bars_spec(
    x = "invid", y = "n", fill = "flag", stat = "identity",
    orientation = "horizontal",
    theme = list(dynamicSizing = TRUE, pxPerCategory = 25)
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-dynamic-many")
)
```
</div>

## Legacy KRI bar chart (relocated wrapper)

<div id="page-legacy-barchart">
```{r legacy-barchart}
# Renders through the relocated Widget_BarChart: binding, YAML, control libs and
# the gsmViz bundle must all resolve from gsm.vizr (not gsm.kri).
dfResults_legacy <- gsm.core::reportingResults %>%
  dplyr::filter(MetricID == "Analysis_kri0001" & SnapshotDate == max(SnapshotDate))
lMetric_legacy <- gsm.core::reportingMetrics %>%
  dplyr::filter(MetricID == "Analysis_kri0001") %>%
  as.list()
Widget_BarChart(
  dfResults = dfResults_legacy,
  dfGroups = gsm.core::reportingGroups,
  lMetric = lMetric_legacy,
  vThreshold = lMetric_legacy$Threshold
)
```
</div>
